text:
Changed app/workers/chat_notification_worker.rb and wrote the reason down in docs/decisions/gitlab-handoff-chatops-timeout.md.

Commit message:
At Kestrel Bank, trace sections arrive through an object-storage sync every 10 minutes, so a 5-minute timeout dropped every ChatOps reply.

writes.docs/decisions/gitlab-handoff-chatops-ti:
# Why app/workers/chat_notification_worker.rb holds this value

At Kestrel Bank, trace sections arrive through an object-storage sync every 10 minutes, so a 5-minute timeout dropped every ChatOps reply.
